description: Four-step programmer — knobs A, B, C and D per step, going to the four outputs when that step is current

params.text: With this on, a clock pulse advances the sequence from step 1 upwards; with it off, a clock pulse runs it backwards
With this on, the voltage at the SELECT input is read only when a clock pulse arrives, rather than continuously
Sets the voltage that row's output carries while that step is the current one, ±10V by default
Makes that step the current one

inputs.text: A rising edge advances the sequence by one step; the channels patched here set the module's polyphony
Adds to the step number, one step per 2.5V and wrapping round at the end; with PGMRX expanders fitted, the volts per step becomes 10V divided by the total step count
A trigger here makes that step the current one

outputs.text: The voltage set by that row's knob on the step now selected
A trigger whenever the step changes
5V for as long as that step is the current one, or a 1ms trigger at the moment of selection if the menu is set to Trigger

notes: takes PGMRX expanders, four steps each
menu: Polyphony channels from — chooses which input sets the module's channel count, CLOCK input or SELECT input
Reverse step on negative clock — a clock pulse that goes below 0V steps backwards, which the FWD/REV switch then reverses again
Triggered select mode — the SELECT input takes triggers that advance a second sequence whose length the SELECT knob sets, instead of reading a voltage
Wrap select at steps — the select value wraps round at the STEPS setting rather than at the full number of steps
Output on selected step — that step's own output emits a Gate lasting as long as the step is current, or a Trigger at the moment it is selected
Save last selected step to patch — stores the step last chosen by a button press or step trigger, and returns to it when the patch is loaded
Range — sets the voltage span the knobs cover: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-2V or 0V-1V
